summary: Breaks quantitative method into numerical computing (NIST GAMS classes D, E, F, H, I), symbolic mathematics, statistics, experimental design, signal and time-series analysis (GAMS J, L and the CRAN Task Views), machine learning (ACM CCS), optimization (GAMS G, MSC 90C) and stochastic simulation; then laboratory science into instrument control, analytical data processing and laboratory informatics (ASTM E1578), survey and behavioral methods, and the molecular sciences split by data type (sequences, genomics, systems biology, molecular modeling, cheminformatics) following EDAM. General tools such as MATLAB, R, SAS, SPSS, Stata and Mathematica are placed here as examples on the tasks they serve.

capabilities.name: Numerical computing
capabilities.definition: Given a mathematical problem stated as matrices, functions or differential equations, compute a floating-point approximate solution with error control.

crosswalk.label: Mathematics of computing > Mathematical analysis > Numerical analysis
Dense linear algebra; Sparse linear algebra; Structured grids; Unstructured grids

onet_categories: Object or component oriented development software
Data base user interface and query software
capabilities.notes: Merges seed 'Numerical computing environments and linear algebra' with the rest of the GAMS numerical classes (D, E, F, H, I, A/C). Interactive environments (MATLAB, Octave, Scilab, Mathcad, IDL) are not a task of their own: they appear as examples on the tasks they serve. Signal transforms (GAMS J) moved to science.signal_time_series.

tasks.name: Flow cytometry analysis

open_questions: This domain has 18 capabilities, above the 6-14 aim, because it covers mathematics, statistics and three laboratory sciences. If the editor wants fewer, the cleanest merges are experimental_design into statistics, systems_biology into genomics, and cheminformatics back into molecular_modeling.

Epidemiological analysis (Epi Info, OpenEpi, SaTScan, ClusterSeer) is population statistics, not patient care. I handed it to health; if health does not take it, it should become a statistics task here (spatial and outbreak statistics).
Geostatistics (kriging, variograms: GSLIB, Gstat, SGeMS) is a general spatial-statistics method but its products are earth-science tools. I handed it to earth; confirm.

Boundary with computing for array libraries: I claimed NumPy, SciPy, R, MATLAB and Octave as numerical or statistical tools, and handed Jupyter, pandas and Julia to computing as programming tools. The editor should fix one rule for this.
Survey fielding (Qualtrics, CATI) is claimed here as research method; commerce may also claim it for market research.
Chromosome image analysis and psychometric calibration are kept here as methods; health (clinical cytogenetics) and learn (testing programs) may contest them.
